description: This HTML file constitutes the front-end interface for a database viewer web application. It provides a user interface for browsing databases, tables, and displaying table data, including features like loading indicators, error handling, expandable cells, and dynamic content updates via embedded JavaScript.
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls for databases, tables, data)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays rows of data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates and inserts the HTML table for displaying data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual data cell, handling special cases like objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when user clicks, handling JSON and long text.
